pairs.question: Quid enim mundo praestantius?
pairs.answer: Lauda, quam putas, speciem: portio a te laudabitur mundi; admirare, quam voles, temperantiam, ordinationem, figuram: hic et per hunc illud quodcumque est invenietur esse laudandum.
pairs.derivation: Authorial rhetorical question opening section XXII, immediately answered by the author himself: whatever you praise turns out to be a portion of, or praiseworthy through, the world. The section marker 'XXII.' was stripped. The answer runs to the first full stop (after 'esse laudandum'); the interior colons are not sentence-ends per the guidance, so they are retained within the single answering sentence. The next sentence ('Nam quid, oro te, ornatum...') begins a fresh rhetorical move and is not included.
